fingerprint_method: Sorted morice/**/*.py or tests/**/*.py: Windows relative path bytes followed by file bytes, SHA-256.
native_scope: Native Qt actions, deterministic scaffold, actual saved files and actual scientific runs. No model inference claim.
controlled_model_checks: Explicit and bundled/default model dispatch receive the complete small project goal; controlled source proposals pass through the existing builder, review, actual disk writes and actual Python unit-test execution. No new real-weight inference was performed.
other_coverage: Project Ask stays in Updates without writes
Explicit no-code instruction retains explanation intent
Project-to-chat navigation preserves drafts and deterministic math fast path
Web Preview reuses the existing browser page and bridge; Tools can reclaim it
Local, relative and standard-library imports do not become pip dependencies
Oversized goals remain stored as partial and do not silently truncate requirements
Missing experiment inputs preserve the draft; natural-language sweep runs without chat fallback
Compact Save/Run controls retain minimum height; review areas scroll
All 65 authored icon names remain valid
Blocked browser/user/permission/environment verification returns without a model source-repair call; a fresh retry can repair code after the environment recovers
Delayed GPU detection ignores a closing window

native_capture.method: Actual owned Qt production window with isolated demonstration profiles, driven through its controls. Not a physical mouse/microphone/device certification.

wheel.dependency_scope: Main installed dependency runtime and a separate existing dependency venv; not a fresh dependency installation.

vnext.scope: Unchanged VNext source; local tests and typecheck passed during this update. Exact-commit CI repeats these checks.

audit.step: Choose a folder and Build/Ask intent
Build, review, save and inspect actual source/output
Describe an experiment or enter required model values
Review inputs, run and inspect stored results

retained_development_failures: An early full run exposed a one-second pairing fixture expiry under concurrent build load; the fixture now controls expiry explicitly while production permissions/TTL stay unchanged. Native compact review inspection caught a squeezed Save button despite the earlier visibility-only check; scroll layout and minimum-height coverage were corrected before the final build. A later full run exposed unnecessary model source repair after browser UserInterventionRequired; the repaired final source stops that attempt and guards a late GPU callback on close.
constraints: Automatic source proposal task budget is 2,000 characters including instructions; Project model output stays bounded at up to 1,024 tokens. Oversized goals are visibly partial. Arbitrary large application generation is not certified.
Toolchains, dependencies, providers and compatible model weights must be installed. Source generation does not imply a compiled executable.
Experiments cover driven oscillator, thermal expansion, ideal mixture density and vacuum particle models. Their stored results are computational outputs, not measured physical validation.
New heavy inference checks remain constrained by about 3.5 GiB available RAM; the user previously accepted documentation of this limit.
Physical audio/camera/Android/provider checks and compositor animation frame pacing are not certified by these software checks.
authorities: Existing CapabilityKernel, TaskGraph, WorkerManager, AgentCoordinator, SharedTaskState, resource leases, verification, permission handling and owned processes are extended, not duplicated.
publication: Release Package-Contents.json binds matching installed and archived checks. Independent CI, Release validation and Pages links plus live-site QA are added to the new release after those exact-commit checks pass.
